boards.school_name: Louisiana State University and Agricultural & Mechanical College
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed stops on the Northgate, Highland Road, Chimes Street, Lake Street, and Nicholson Drive corridors beside LSU.

cards.title: The Chimes — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Use the Highland Road location for its made-from-scratch menu; check the restaurant’s current menu and service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Northgate restaurant with a documented made-from-scratch menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chimes lists its Highland location at 3357 Highland Road and describes a made-from-scratch menu.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; confirm current hours and seating directly with the venue.

cards.title: Highland Coffees — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor at Chimes Street
cards.notes: Order a coffee or tea, then use the shop’s courtyard or seating for a reading break; the business places itself by LSU’s historic North Gates.
cards.short_summary: Coffee and tea shop at LSU’s historic North Gates.
cards.evidence_claim: Highland Coffees says it has operated since 1989 near the Highland Road–Chimes Street corner at LSU’s historic North Gates.
cards.access_notes: Commercial coffee shop; purchases are optional for viewing the location, but menu items require payment.

cards.title: Varsity Theatre — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Check the event calendar and ticket rules before planning a show; the historic venue is a clearly photographed landmark along the Northgate strip.
cards.short_summary: Historic event venue on the Northgate stretch of Highland Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Baton Rouge identifies Varsity Theatre at 3353 Highland Road near LSU and describes it as a historic event venue.
cards.access_notes: Event access varies by program; review the specific event’s age and ticket requirements.

cards.title: Roul’s Deli — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Use this stop for sandwiches, burgers, salads, or hot plates; the listed Highland location is a short Northgate-side option beside campus.
cards.short_summary: Deli-format meal stop on Highland Road near LSU.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Baton Rouge lists Roul’s Deli at 3327 Highland Road near LSU and identifies sandwiches, burgers, salads, and hot plates.
cards.source_title: Roul's Deli - Highland Road | Visit Baton Rouge
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; verify current operating details before visiting.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s #1 — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Visit the location identified as “Cane’s 1 - The Mothership” and use its official page to confirm dine-in, drive-through, or pickup availability.
cards.short_summary: The original Raising Cane’s location, documented as Cane’s 1.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s identifies 3313 Highland Road as “Cane’s 1 - The Mothership.”
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows late-night hours; check the current location page for day-specific closing times.

cards.title: Louie’s Café — Lake Street
cards.subtitle: Lake Street corridor by LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Plan a breakfast or lunch stop on Lake Street and check the café’s current service details; its official site identifies the address and daytime schedule.
cards.short_summary: Long-running Lake Street café with breakfast and lunch service.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie’s Café lists 3322 Lake Street and says it has served breakfast, lunch, and brunch since 1941.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily service from 6:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Cherrybomb Coffee — West Chimes Street
cards.subtitle: West Chimes Street corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Choose coffee, tea, nitro cold brew, or a pastry at the West Chimes location, then confirm current seasonal hours from the shop before visiting.
cards.short_summary: Coffee-and-pastry stop on West Chimes Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherrybomb Coffee lists its Baton Rouge location at 136 W Chimes Street with specialty coffee, teas, nitro cold brew, and pastries.
cards.access_notes: Official page notes seasonal hours; check it for the current schedule.

cards.title: Bengals and Bandits — Highland Road
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Browse the shop’s licensed apparel and local-design selections at the North Gates; confirm current stock or store hours directly before making a trip.
cards.short_summary: Northgate retail stop for licensed apparel and local design work.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Baton Rouge lists Bengals and Bandits at 3340 Highland Road and says it offers licensed apparel and items from local artists and designers.
cards.source_title: Bengals and Bandits - LSU Northgate | Visit Baton Rouge
cards.access_notes: Retail shop; purchases depend on selected merchandise.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies — West Chimes Street
cards.subtitle: West Chimes Street corridor, LSU Northgate
cards.notes: Use the named West Chimes storefront as a dessert stop, and check the official location information for current ordering and service options.
cards.short_summary: Map-listed cookie shop on the West Chimes corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Baton Rouge’s Near LSU map lists Insomnia Cookies at 128 W Chimes Street in Baton Rouge.
cards.source_title: Near LSU Neighborhood Map | Visit Baton Rouge
cards.access_notes: Retail food service; verify current hours and ordering options with the business.

cards.title: City Slice — Nicholson Drive
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Drive corridor south of campus
cards.notes: Use the Nicholson Drive storefront as a pizza stop when traveling south from campus; confirm current menu, ordering, and service details before going.
cards.short_summary: Map-listed pizza stop on the Nicholson Drive campus corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Baton Rouge’s Near LSU map lists City Slice at 4225 Nicholson Drive in Baton Rouge.
cards.source_title: Near LSU Neighborhood Map | Visit Baton Rouge
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; confirm current hours and ordering policies directly with the business.
